Trueup finds where your AI agent's traces disagree with what really happened, fixes the tracing code, and proves the fix.

## What it does

Teams watch their AI agents through tracing libraries such as neatlogs, OpenInference and OpenLLMetry. These libraries wrap the AI provider's SDK and record each call. When a wrapper gets a case wrong, the dashboard can show a crashed run as OK, miss a refusal, or show twice the real cost.

Trueup runs the agent against a fake provider, so it knows what really happened. It captures what the trace says and compares the two. When they disagree, it looks for the cause in the tracing library, writes a fix with a test, and checks that the fix works.

The work is split into small workers: planner, runner, comparer, checker, deduper, fixer, verifier and reporter. A language model proposes; plain code decides.

## Status: early build

`trueup doctor`, `trueup sweep <neatlogs|openinference|openllmetry>` and `trueup audit <script> --library <lib>` work.

`sweep` runs the plain-SDK scenarios against a fake provider, compares truth with the trace, prints a table of leads and writes truth, trace and `leads.json` to `.trueup/runs/<run_id>/`. A lead is a disagreement between truth and trace; it is not a confirmed bug.

`audit` runs your script's `main()` against the fake (through `OPENAI_BASE_URL` / `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) under the chosen library, once per fake scenario on each provider route the script calls, and compares the same way. It needs a `main()` with no arguments that uses the `openai` or `anthropic` SDK; see `src/trueup/audit.py` for its limits.

The other commands (`fix`, `upstream`, `verify`, `report`) print "not built yet" and exit 2.

Exit codes: 0 no leads, 1 leads found, 2 could not run.

## Run it

Needs Python 3.12 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).

```sh
uv sync
uv run trueup doctor
uv run pytest -q         # offline unit tests
uv run pytest -q -m e2e  # builds per-library venvs, runs subprocesses
uv run trueup sweep neatlogs
uv run trueup audit examples/agent.py --library openinference
```

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
# Build log

neatHack, 10-12 Oct 2026.

## 2026-10-10: skeleton

- Set up the uv project (Python 3.12, src layout) with the `trueup` command.
- Added the data model in `trueup.core`: Observation, Mismatch, Run, Finding and Severity, each with `to_dict`/`from_dict`.
- `trueup doctor` reports the Python version and whether the two keys are set, without printing them. Other commands exit 2 with "not built yet".
- Tests for the round trip, severity order and doctor. CI runs them on push.
- Nothing is audited yet. No findings so far.

## 2026-10-10: the truth side

- `trueup.fake`: a local fake provider (stdlib http.server in a thread, random free port). It speaks OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages. The request's model name picks the scenario: plain, streamed with and without usage, two parallel tool calls with split streamed arguments, refusal, n=2, HTTP 500 and 529, error event mid-stream, status failed and incomplete, reasoning summary, thinking, tool_use with input_json_delta, and a dropped connection. Every id is unique per call and per fake instance. The truth log records each request and what was sent back, including tokens per call, or that no usage was sent.
- 34 fixture tests run the real `openai` and `anthropic` SDKs against the fake. Two SDK behaviours we found and recorded: the openai SDK passes a Responses `error` event to the app instead of raising, and the anthropic SDK lets a dropped stream through as a raw `RemoteProtocolError`, not an SDK exception.
- `trueup.scenarios`: 31 plain-SDK scenarios as data (chat 12, Responses 9, Anthropic 10), each with expected truth. A unit test runs every app with no tracing library and checks the expectations against what really happens. That check caught one wrong expectation (streamed tool calls without include_usage carry no tokens). 20 LangChain/LangGraph/OpenAI Agents cases are listed as not_built.
- `trueup.runner`: runs one scenario in a fresh subprocess in `.trueup/venvs/<lib>` (built with uv), using the library's recommended setup and an in-memory span exporter. It returns truth plus spans as JSON. A scenario that cannot run is reported NOT RUN with the reason.
- Regression tests for four traps: reused response ids, a reused async client across asyncio.run, a missing-usage reply read as a bug, and neatlogs exporting to a dead endpoint.
- `trueup sweep <library>` writes observations and `summary.txt` to `.trueup/runs/<run_id>/`. All three libraries ran 31/31. The first openllmetry sweep was 0/31 NOT RUN because `traceloop-sdk` imports `httpx` without declaring it; we now install `httpx` in that venv.
- Leads for the comparer (not judged yet): neatlogs adds `stream_options.include_usage` to the app's streamed chat request. openinference exports no span for a stream closed early, or for a Responses stream that ends with an error event. openllmetry marks chat streams that raised (error event, cut) as OK, and exports no span for Responses failed/incomplete or for Anthropic stream errors and cuts.

## 2026-10-10: the comparer and the reports

- `trueup.core.compare` checks truth against the spans: run status, call status, call count, span closed, tokens, output (text, refusal, tool calls with arguments compared as JSON), finish, plus a "request changed" note. Severity: HIGH changes a number or status a dashboard shows by default, MEDIUM is wrong or missing span detail, LOW is extra or cosmetic.
- `trueup.core.adapters`: one data-driven adapter per library saying where it keeps tokens, finish reasons, outputs and response ids. Tested against span JSON from the sweeps, saved in `tests/fixtures/spans/` with stack traces and local URLs removed. OpenLLMetry error spans for failed Responses streams have no `gen_ai.operation.name`, so its adapter keys on `gen_ai.provider.name`.
- Choices made while comparing: finish reasons are compared through a synonym table (end_turn = stop, tool_use = tool_calls = tool_call, incomplete = length), because OpenLLMetry normalises them; a completed Responses call that asked for a tool may show `tool_call`. When the app closes a stream early, output, tokens and finish are not compared, since the app never got them. Tokens are only compared when the fake sent usage. Spans are matched to calls by response id, then by start order.
- A mismatch is called a lead. `trueup sweep <lib>` now prints a leads table, writes `leads.json` and exits 1 if there is any lead.
- `trueup audit <agent.py> --library <lib>` runs the script's `main()` against the fake, once per fake scenario on each route the script calls, and compares. Limits are written in `src/trueup/audit.py`. Tried on `examples/agent.py` under openinference: 8 runs, 1 lead (refusal not recorded).

Sweeps after the comparer (31/31 ran for each library). These are leads, not confirmed bugs; the self-check comes next.

| library | leads | high | medium | low | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| neatlogs | 22 | 4 | 18 | 0 | 5 |
| openinference | 10 | 2 | 8 | 0 | 0 |
| openllmetry | 14 | 11 | 3 | 0 | 0 |

Leads per check:

| check | neatlogs | openinference | openllmetry |
|---|---|---|---|
| run_status | 1 | 0 | 3 |
| call_status | 1 | 0 | 3 |
| call_count | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| span_closed | 0 | 2 | 4 |
| tokens | 3 | 0 | 4 |
| output | 7 | 1 | 0 |
| finish | 10 | 7 | 0 |

- neatlogs: Anthropic `messages.stream` spans carry no tokens, text, tool calls or finish reason (3 scenarios); Responses spans carry no status/finish (7) and no function calls (2); the chat refusal is not recorded; the Responses stream that ends with an error event stays UNSET with no exception event. The 5 notes are neatlogs adding `stream_options.include_usage` to streamed chat requests; tokens were compared against what the fake really sent.
- openinference: no span for a chat stream closed early or for a Responses stream ending in an error event; Responses spans carry no status/finish (7); the chat refusal is not recorded.
- openllmetry: chat streams that raised (error event, cut) and the Responses error-event stream end OK; no span for Responses failed/incomplete or for Anthropic stream error/cut; Anthropic streamed spans record 4 output tokens where the provider sent 3 (4 scenarios).
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Comparer (`trueup.core.compare`): checks run status, call status, call count, span closed, tokens, output and finish, with HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severity. Records a library changing the request (such as adding `stream_options.include_usage`) as a LOW note.
- Adapters (`trueup.core.adapters`): one per library for neatlogs, OpenInference and OpenLLMetry, tested on saved span JSON in `tests/fixtures/spans/`.
- Reports (`trueup.core.report`): leads table and `leads.json`.
- `trueup sweep <library>` compares, prints the leads table, writes `leads.json`, and exits 1 if there is any lead.
- `trueup audit <script> --library <library>`: runs the script's `main()` against the fake through `OPENAI_BASE_URL` / `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, once per fake scenario on each route it calls, and compares. Example script in `examples/agent.py`.
- The fake provider can be told which scenario to answer with on a route, whatever the model name.
- `Mismatch` has `check` and `kind` ("lead" or "note").
- Fake provider (`trueup.fake`) for OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages, with a truth log.
- Scenario library (`trueup.scenarios`): 31 plain-SDK scenarios; framework scenarios listed as not built.
- Runner (`trueup.runner`): one scenario per subprocess in a per-library uv venv (neatlogs, openinference, openllmetry), spans captured in memory.
- `trueup sweep <library>` writes observations to `.trueup/runs/<run_id>/`.
- Dev dependencies: `openai`, `anthropic`. Tests that spawn subprocesses are marked `e2e` and excluded by default.
- Project skeleton: uv project, `trueup` command, data model in `trueup.core`, `doctor` command, tests and CI.

# Agent-framework scenarios on each library's recommended setup.
# Truth = what the app saw + what the fake server received (LLM calls, tokens) + which tools really ran/raised.
import sys, os, json, gc, asyncio, time, logging
logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__)); import fake2
LIB = sys.argv[1]; ONLY = sys.argv[2:]
port = fake2.start(); base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
os.environ.update(OPENAI_API_KEY="x", OPENAI_BASE_URL=base + "/v1", TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT="true",
                  OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT="true")
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
exp = InMemorySpanExporter()
if LIB == "neatlogs":
    import neatlogs
    neatlogs.init(api_key="nl-dummy", instrumentations=["langchain", "openai_agents"], disable_export=True)
    sys.modules["neatlogs.init"]._tracer_provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exp))
else:
    tp = TracerProvider(); tp.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exp))
    if LIB == "oi":
        from openinference.instrumentation.langchain import LangChainInstrumentor
        from openinference.instrumentation.openai_agents import OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor
        LangChainInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=tp); OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=tp)
    else:
        from opentelemetry.instrumentation.langchain import LangchainInstrumentor
        from opentelemetry.instrumentation.openai_agents import OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor
        from opentelemetry.instrumentation.openai import OpenAIInstrumentor
        LangchainInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=tp); OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=tp)
        OpenAIInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=tp)

from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.tools import tool
from langgraph.prebuilt import create_react_agent
TOOLRUNS = []

@tool
def get_weather(city: str) -> str:
    """Get the weather for a city."""
    TOOLRUNS.append(("ok", city)); return f"Sunny in {city}"

@tool
def get_weather_broken(city: str) -> str:
    """Get the weather for a city."""
    TOOLRUNS.append(("raised", city)); raise RuntimeError("weather service down")
get_weather_broken.name = "get_weather"

def llm(model, **kw): return ChatOpenAI(model=model, api_key="x", base_url=base + "/v1", max_retries=0, **kw)

def lg(model, tools, inp="weather in Lagos?", stream=False, **cfg):
    g = create_react_agent(llm(model), tools)
    if stream:
        txt = ""
        for chunk, meta in g.stream({"messages": [("user", inp)]}, stream_mode="messages", config=cfg or None):
            txt += getattr(chunk, "content", "") if isinstance(getattr(chunk, "content", ""), str) else ""
        return {"answer": txt[-40:]}
    r = g.invoke({"messages": [("user", inp)]}, config=cfg or None)
    return {"answer": r["messages"][-1].content}

import agents
from agents import Agent, Runner, function_tool, set_default_openai_client, set_default_openai_api
from openai import AsyncOpenAI
set_default_openai_client(AsyncOpenAI(api_key="x", base_url=base + "/v1", max_retries=0), use_for_tracing=False)

@function_tool(name_override="get_weather")
def weather(city: str) -> str:
    """Get the weather for a city."""
    TOOLRUNS.append(("ok", city)); return f"Sunny in {city}"

@function_tool(name_override="get_weather")
def weather_broken(city: str) -> str:
    """Get the weather for a city."""
    TOOLRUNS.append(("raised", city)); raise RuntimeError("weather service down")

def oas(model, tools, max_turns=10):
    a = Agent(name="helper", instructions="help", model=model, tools=tools)
    async def go():
        res = Runner.run_streamed(a, "weather in Lagos?", max_turns=max_turns)
        async for _ in res.stream_events(): pass
        return res.final_output
    return {"answer": asyncio.run(go())}

def oa(model, tools, max_turns=10):
    a = Agent(name="helper", instructions="help", model=model, tools=tools)
    r = Runner.run_sync(a, "weather in Lagos?", max_turns=max_turns)
    return {"answer": r.final_output}

SC = {
 "lc_invoke":     lambda: {"answer": llm("plain").invoke("hi").content},
 "lc_stream":     lambda: {"answer": "".join(c.content for c in llm("s_plain", stream_usage=True).stream("hi"))},
 "lc_stream_err": lambda: {"answer": "".join(c.content for c in llm("s_errevent").stream("hi"))},
 "lc_stream_cut": lambda: {"answer": "".join(c.content for c in llm("s_cut").stream("hi"))},
 "lc_refusal":    lambda: (lambda m: {"answer": m.content, "refusal": m.additional_kwargs.get("refusal")})(llm("refusal").invoke("hi")),
 "lc_err500":     lambda: llm("err500").invoke("hi"),
 "lg_agent":      lambda: lg("ag", [get_weather]),
 "lg_tool_raises":lambda: lg("ag", [get_weather_broken]),
 "lg_llm_fails":  lambda: lg("ag_err2", [get_weather]),
 "lg_parallel":   lambda: lg("ag_par", [get_weather]),
 "lg_stream":     lambda: lg("ag", [get_weather], stream=True),
 "lg_recursion":  lambda: lg("ag_loop", [get_weather], recursion_limit=6),
 "oa_agent":      lambda: oa("oa_ok", [weather]),
 "oa_tool_raises":lambda: oa("oa_ok", [weather_broken]),
 "oa_llm_fails":  lambda: oa("oa_err2", [weather]),
 "oa_max_turns":  lambda: oa("oa_loop", [weather], max_turns=3),
 "oa_bad_tool":   lambda: oa("oa_badtool", [weather]),
 "oas_ok":        lambda: oas("oas_ok", [weather]),
 "oas_err":       lambda: oas("oas_err", [weather]),
 "oas_cut":       lambda: oas("oas_cut", [weather]),
}

def kind(sp):
    a = sp.attributes
    k = a.get("openinference.span.kind") or a.get("neatlogs.span.kind") or a.get("traceloop.span.kind") or a.get("gen_ai.operation.name") or ""
    return str(k).lower()

def tok(sp):
    a = sp.attributes
    for key in ("llm.token_count.total", "neatlogs.llm.token_count.total", "gen_ai.usage.total_tokens", "llm.usage.total_tokens"):
        if key in a: return int(a[key])
    i = a.get("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"); o = a.get("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens")
    return int(i) + int(o) if i is not None and o is not None else None

res = {}
for name, fn in SC.items():
    if ONLY and name not in ONLY: continue
    exp.clear(); fake2.LOG.clear(); TOOLRUNS.clear(); truth = {}
    try: truth = fn() or {}
    except Exception as e: truth = {"app_error": type(e).__name__}
    gc.collect(); time.sleep(0.3)
    if LIB == "neatlogs": neatlogs.flush()
    spans = exp.get_finished_spans()
    ids = {s.context.span_id for s in spans}
    llm_sp = [s for s in spans if kind(s) in ("llm", "chat", "text_completion") or s.name.startswith(("openai.chat", "ChatOpenAI", "openai.response"))]
    tool_sp = [s for s in spans if kind(s) in ("tool", "execute_tool")]

LOG = []
U = {"prompt_tokens": 11, "completion_tokens": 7, "total_tokens": 18}
RU = {"input_tokens": 11, "output_tokens": 7, "total_tokens": 18, "input_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 0}, "output_tokens_details": {"reasoning_tokens": 0}}

def chat_agent(sc, req):
    msgs = req.get("messages", [])
    n_llm = sum(1 for r in LOG if r["kind"] == "chat")
    has_tool_result = bool(msgs) and msgs[-1].get("role") == "tool"
    if sc == "ag_err2" and n_llm >= 2:
        return 500, "application/json", json.dumps({"error": {"message": "boom", "type": "server_error"}}).encode()
    if sc == "ag_loop" or not has_tool_result:
        if sc == "ag_par":
            tcs = [{"id": f"call_{n_llm}a", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": "{\"city\": \"Lagos\"}"}},
                   {"id": f"call_{n_llm}b", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": "{\"city\": \"Abuja\"}"}}]
        else:
            tcs = [{"id": f"call_{n_llm}", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": "{\"city\": \"Lagos\"}"}}]
        msg, fr = {"role": "assistant", "content": None, "tool_calls": tcs}, "tool_calls"
    else:
        msg, fr = {"role": "assistant", "content": "It is sunny in Lagos."}, "stop"
    if req.get("stream"):
        p = [fake.oa_chunk({"role": "assistant", "content": ""})]
        if msg.get("tool_calls"):
            for i, tc in enumerate(msg["tool_calls"]):
                p.append(fake.oa_chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": i, "id": tc["id"], "type": "function", "function": {"name": tc["function"]["name"], "arguments": ""}}]}))
                p.append(fake.oa_chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": i, "function": {"arguments": tc["function"]["arguments"]}}]}))
        else:
            p += [fake.oa_chunk({"content": "It is sunny "}), fake.oa_chunk({"content": "in Lagos."})]
        p.append(fake.oa_chunk({}, fr))
        if (req.get("stream_options") or {}).get("include_usage"):

def resp_agent(sc, req):
    n_llm = sum(1 for r in LOG if r["kind"] == "responses")
    inp = req.get("input")
    has_out = isinstance(inp, list) and any(isinstance(i, dict) and i.get("type") == "function_call_output" for i in inp)
    if sc == "oa_err2" and n_llm >= 2:
        return 500, "application/json", json.dumps({"error": {"message": "boom", "type": "server_error"}}).encode()
    if sc == "oa_loop" or not has_out:
        out = [{"type": "function_call", "id": f"fc_{n_llm}", "call_id": f"call_{n_llm}", "name": "no_such_tool" if sc == "oa_badtool" else "get_weather", "arguments": "{\"city\":\"Lagos\"}", "status": "completed"}]
        text = ""
    else:
        out = [{"type": "message", "id": f"msg_{n_llm}", "role": "assistant", "status": "completed", "content": [{"type": "output_text", "text": "It is sunny in Lagos.", "annotations": []}]}]
        text = "It is sunny in Lagos."
    body = {"id": f"resp_{sc}_{n_llm}", "object": "response", "created_at": 0, "status": "completed", "model": "gpt-x", "output": out,
            "parallel_tool_calls": True, "tool_choice": "auto", "tools": [], "usage": RU}
    if not req.get("stream"):
        return 200, "application/json", json.dumps(body).encode()
    # Streaming: the Responses API event sequence.
    seq = [0]
    def ev(t, **d):
        d["type"] = t; d["sequence_number"] = seq[0]; seq[0] += 1
        return f"event: {t}\ndata: {json.dumps(d)}\n\n".encode()
    start = dict(body, status="in_progress", output=[], usage=None)
    p = [ev("response.created", response=start), ev("response.in_progress", response=start)]
    for i, item in enumerate(out):
        added = dict(item, status="in_progress")
        if item["type"] == "message": added["content"] = []
        if item["type"] == "function_call": added["arguments"] = ""
        p.append(ev("response.output_item.added", output_index=i, item=added))
        if item["type"] == "message":
            p.append(ev("response.content_part.added", item_id=item["id"], output_index=i, content_index=0, part={"type": "output_text", "text": "", "annotations": []}))
            p.append(ev("response.output_text.delta", item_id=item["id"], output_index=i, content_index=0, delta="It is sunny ", logprobs=[]))
            if sc.startswith("oas_err") and n_llm >= 1:
                p.append(ev("error", code="server_error", message="stream failed", param=None)); return 200, "text/event-stream", b"".join(p)
            if sc.startswith("oas_cut") and n_llm >= 1:
                return 200, "text/event-stream", ("CUT", b"".join(p))
            p.append(ev("response.output_text.delta", item_id=item["id"], output_index=i, content_index=0, delta="in Lagos.", logprobs=[]))
            p.append(ev("response.output_text.done", item_id=item["id"], output_index=i, content_index=0, text=text, logprobs=[]))
            p.append(ev("response.content_part.done", item_id=item["id"], output_index=i, content_index=0, part=item["content"][0]))
        else:
            p.append(ev("response.function_call_arguments.delta", item_id=item["id"], output_index=i, delta=item["arguments"]))
            p.append(ev("response.function_call_arguments.done", item_id=item["id"], output_index=i, arguments=item["arguments"], name=item["name"]))
        p.append(ev("response.output_item.done", output_index=i, item=item))
    p.append(ev("response.completed", response=body))
    return 200, "text/event-stream", b"".join(p)

    def do_POST(self):
        raw = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
        req = json.loads(raw); sc = req.get("model", "")
        kind = "responses" if self.path.endswith("/responses") else "messages" if self.path.endswith("/messages") else "chat"
        LOG.append({"kind": kind, "model": sc, "stream": bool(req.get("stream"))})
        if sc.startswith("ag"): code, ct, body = chat_agent(sc, req)
        elif sc.startswith(("oa_", "oas_")) and kind == "responses": code, ct, body = resp_agent(sc, req)
        else:
            fn = fake.an_msg if kind == "messages" else fake.responses if kind == "responses" else fake.oa_chat
            code, ct, body = fn(sc, req)
        if isinstance(body, tuple):
            self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Content-Type", ct); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body[1]) + 500)); self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body[1]); self.wfile.flush(); self.connection.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR); self.close_connection = True; return
        self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Content-Type", ct); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)

def start():
    s = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H); threading.Thread(target=s.serve_forever, daemon=True).start(); return s.server_port

def _read_chat_stream(stream) -> dict[str, Any]:
    out: dict[str, Any] = {"text": "", "tool_calls": {}, "finish": None, "total_tokens": None}
    for ch in stream:
        if ch.usage:
            out["total_tokens"] = ch.usage.total_tokens
        for c in ch.choices:
            out["text"] += c.delta.content or ""
            out["finish"] = c.finish_reason or out["finish"]
            for tc in c.delta.tool_calls or []:
                d = out["tool_calls"].setdefault(str(tc.index), {"name": "", "arguments": ""})
                d["name"] += tc.function.name or ""
                d["arguments"] += tc.function.arguments or ""
    out["tool_calls"] = list(out["tool_calls"].values())

        async with openai.AsyncOpenAI(api_key="trueup-fake", base_url=f"{base}/v1", max_retries=0) as c:

    with _oa(base) as c:
        with c.responses.stream(model=model, input="What is the weather in Lagos?", tools=RESP_TOOLS) as s:
            for _ in s:
                pass

    # The SDK yields a Responses `error` event instead of raising; an app

    with _oa(base) as c:

ATTR_MAX = 2000


def _value(v: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(v, (tuple, list)):
        return [_value(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v, str) and len(v) > ATTR_MAX:
        return v[:ATTR_MAX] + f"...[{len(v) - ATTR_MAX} more chars]"
    return v


def span_to_dict(s: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ctx = s.get_span_context()
    return {
        "name": s.name,
        "kind": s.kind.name,
        "trace_id": format(ctx.trace_id, "032x"),
        "span_id": format(ctx.span_id, "016x"),
        "parent_id": format(s.parent.span_id, "016x") if s.parent else None,
        "start_ns": s.start_time,
        "end_ns": s.end_time,
        "status": {"code": s.status.status_code.name, "description": s.status.description},
        "scope": s.instrumentation_scope.name if s.instrumentation_scope else None,
        "attributes": {k: _value(v) for k, v in (s.attributes or {}).items()},
        "events": [{"name": e.name, "attributes": {k: _value(v) for k, v in (e.attributes or {}).items()}} for e in s.events],
    }


def _versions(library: str) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    out: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for dist in VERSIONED[library]:
        try:
            out[dist] = metadata.version(dist)
        except metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
            out[dist] = None
    return out


def run(library: str, scenario_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    scenario = get(scenario_id)
    logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
    exporter, flush = SETUPS[library]()
    app_fn = APPS[scenario.app]
    with FakeProvider() as fake:
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        try:
            result = app_fn(fake.base_url, scenario.model)
            app = {"outcome": "ok", "result": result}
        except BaseException as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - the outcome is the data
            app = {
                "outcome": "exception",
                "exception_type": type(e).__name__,
                "exception_module": type(e).__module__,
                "message": str(e)[:500],
            }
        app["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 3)
        # Let streams closed by garbage collection end their spans.
        gc.collect()
        flush()
        fake_log = fake.log.entries()
    spans = [span_to_dict(s) for s in exporter.get_finished_spans()]
    t = truth.derive(fake_log, app)
    return {
        "truth": {
            **t,
            "scenario": scenario_id,
            "expected": scenario.expected,
            "expected_mismatch": truth.check_expected(scenario.expected, t),
            "app": app,
            "fake_log": fake_log,
        },
        "trace": {"library": library, "versions": _versions(library), "spans": spans},
    }


def _load_main(script: str) -> Any:
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("trueup_audit_target", script)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise ImportError(f"cannot load {script}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(script)))
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    fn = getattr(module, "main", None)
    if not callable(fn):
        raise AttributeError(f"{script} has no main()")
    return fn


def run_audit(library: str, script: str, overrides: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run a user's main() with the SDKs pointed at the fake through env base URLs."""
    logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
    exporter, flush = SETUPS[library]()
    with FakeProvider(overrides) as fake:
        os.environ["OPENAI_BASE_URL"] = fake.openai_base_url
        os.environ["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"] = fake.base_url
        main_fn = _load_main(script)
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        try:
            result = main_fn()
            if inspect.iscoroutine(result):
                result = asyncio.run(result)
            app = {"outcome": "ok", "result": repr(result)[:500]}
        except BaseException as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - the outcome is the data
            app = {
                "outcome": "exception",
                "exception_type": type(e).__name__,
                "exception_module": type(e).__module__,
                "message": str(e)[:500],
            }
        app["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 3)
        gc.collect()
        flush()
        fake_log = fake.log.entries()
    spans = [span_to_dict(s) for s in exporter.get_finished_spans()]
    return {
        "truth": {**truth.derive(fake_log, app), "overrides": overrides, "app": app, "fake_log": fake_log},
        "trace": {"library": library, "versions": _versions(library), "spans": spans},
    }


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    if argv[0] == "--audit":
        library, script, overrides_path, out_path = argv[1:]
        with open(overrides_path) as f:
            overrides = json.load(f)
        job = lambda: run_audit(library, script, overrides)  # noqa: E731
    else:
        library, scenario_id, out_path = argv
        job = lambda: run(library, scenario_id)  # noqa: E731
    try:
        payload = {"ok": True, "observation": job()}
    except BaseException:  # noqa: BLE001 - reported as NOT RUN by the parent
        payload = {"ok": False, "error": traceback.format_exc(limit=8)}
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(payload, f, default=str)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

def _last_line(text: str) -> str:
    lines = [ln for ln in text.strip().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    return lines[-1].strip() if lines else "no output"

    """Returns {scenario, library, status, reason, seconds, observation}."""
    try:
        scenario = get(scenario_id)
    except KeyError as e:

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="trueup-") as tmp:

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="trueup-") as tmp:
        out = Path(tmp) / "obs.json"

        t0 = time.monotonic()

            p = subprocess.run(cmd, env=child_env(), cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            return not_run(label, library, f"timed out after {timeout:.0f} s", time.monotonic() - t0)
        except OSError as e:
            return not_run(label, library, f"could not start {python}: {e}")

    llm = [(s, facts(adapter, s)) for s in spans if is_llm_span(adapter, s)]
    app_raised = truth.get("outcome") == "exception"
    out: list[Mismatch] = []

    # run_status
    tops = top_level(spans)
    if tops:
        codes = [s["status"]["code"] for s in tops]
        if app_raised and "ERROR" not in codes:
            out.append(_lead("run_status", "top-level span status", f"ERROR (app raised {truth.get('exception')})",
                             "/".join(codes), HIGH))
        failed_reply = any(c.get("outcome") == "failed" for c in calls)
        if not app_raised and "ERROR" in codes and not failed_reply:
            out.append(_lead("run_status", "top-level span status", "not ERROR (app got a result)", "ERROR", HIGH))

    match = match_calls(calls, llm)

    # call_count: extra LLM spans (duplicates). Missing ones are span_closed.
    if len(llm) > len(calls):
        out.append(_lead("call_count", "LLM spans", f"{len(calls)} (provider requests)", len(llm), HIGH))

    tokens_sum_ok = True
    if len(llm) == len(calls) and any(c.get("usage_sent") for c in calls):
        real = sum(c["usage"]["input_tokens"] + c["usage"]["output_tokens"] for c in calls if c.get("usage_sent"))
        seen = sum((f.input_tokens or 0) + (f.output_tokens or 0) for _, f in llm)
        tokens_sum_ok = real == seen

    expected_tokens = (truth.get("expected") or {}).get("tokens")
    partial = _partial_read(truth)

    for ci, call in enumerate(calls):
        where = f"call {ci + 1}"
        outcome = call.get("outcome")
        si = match[ci]

        # request_changed (note): the app did not ask for usage, the request carried include_usage.
        if (isinstance(expected_tokens, list) and ci < len(expected_tokens) and expected_tokens[ci] is None
                and call.get("include_usage")):
            out.append(Mismatch(field=f"{where} stream_options.include_usage", truth="not set by the app",
                                trace="set in the request the provider got", severity=LOW,
                                check="request_changed", kind="note"))

        if si is None:
            out.append(_lead("span_closed", f"{where} span", f"ended and exported ({outcome})", "no span", HIGH))
            continue
        span, f = llm[si]

        if outcome in FAILED_CALL:
            has_exc = any(e.get("name") == "exception" for e in span.get("events", []))
            if span["status"]["code"] != "ERROR" or not has_exc:
                actual = span["status"]["code"] + ("" if has_exc else ", no exception event")
                out.append(_lead("call_status", f"{where} span status", f"ERROR with exception event ({outcome})",
                                 actual, MEDIUM))

        if call.get("usage_sent") and not partial:
            want = {"input": call["usage"]["input_tokens"], "output": call["usage"]["output_tokens"]}
            got = {"input": f.input_tokens, "output": f.output_tokens}
            if want != got:
                out.append(_lead("tokens", f"{where} tokens", want, got, MEDIUM if tokens_sum_ok else HIGH))

        if outcome in COMPLETE_CALL and not partial:
            recorded = set(f.texts) | set(f.refusals)
            for t in call.get("text") or []:
                if t and t not in recorded:
                    out.append(_lead("output", f"{where} output text", t, sorted(recorded) or None, MEDIUM))
            want_tools = call.get("tool_calls") or []
            got_tools = list(f.tool_calls)
            if len(want_tools) != len(got_tools) or not all(
                w["name"] == g[0] and _args_equal(w["arguments"], g[1]) for w, g in zip(want_tools, got_tools)
            ):
                out.append(_lead("output", f"{where} tool calls",
                                 [[w["name"], w["arguments"]] for w in want_tools] or None,
                                 [[g[0], g[1]] for g in got_tools] or None, MEDIUM))

        if outcome in ("complete", "incomplete", "failed") and not partial and call.get("finish"):
            want_f = {norm_finish(x) for x in call["finish"]}
            got_f = {norm_finish(x) for x in f.finish}
            errored = span["status"]["code"] == "ERROR"
            if outcome == "failed":
                ok = errored or "failed" in got_f
            elif outcome == "incomplete":
                ok = errored or "length" in got_f
            elif want_f == {"stop"} and call.get("tool_calls") and "completed" in call["finish"]:
                # A completed Responses call that asks for tools: "tool_call" says the same thing.
                ok = got_f in ({"stop"}, {"tool_call"})
            else:
                ok = want_f == got_f
            if not ok:
                out.append(_lead("finish", f"{where} finish", sorted(call["finish"]),
                                 sorted(f.finish) or None, MEDIUM))
    return out


def leads(mismatches: list[Mismatch]) -> list[Mismatch]:
    return [m for m in mismatches if m.kind == "lead"]
"""Where each tracing library keeps the facts the comparer needs. Pure, data-driven.

One Adapter per library. Each names the attribute keys (or key patterns) for:
which spans are LLM calls, tokens, finish reasons, output text, refusals and
tool calls. Two shapes exist: flat attributes with numeric indexes
(neatlogs, OpenInference) and one JSON attribute holding the output messages
(OpenLLMetry's gen_ai.output.messages).

Adding a library means adding one Adapter here, not changing the comparer.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

# Finish reasons with the same meaning, mapped to one name. OpenLLMetry
# normalises to the OTel GenAI names (stop, tool_call, length); the providers
# and the other libraries keep the raw ones.
FINISH_SYNONYMS = {
    "end_turn": "stop",
    "stop_sequence": "stop",
    "completed": "stop",
    "tool_calls": "tool_call",
    "tool_use": "tool_call",
    "function_call": "tool_call",
    "max_tokens": "length",
    "incomplete": "length",
}


def norm_finish(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    return None if value is None else FINISH_SYNONYMS.get(value, value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Adapter:
    library: str
    # A span is an LLM call if attributes[key] is in values (any value if values is empty).
    llm_kind: tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]
    input_tokens: tuple[str, ...]
    output_tokens: tuple[str, ...]
    response_id: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    # Keys whose value is one finish reason or a list of them; regexes match indexed keys.
    finish: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    # Flat shape: regexes over attribute keys. Tool name/arguments regexes have
    # one group per index, used to pair a name with its arguments.
    text: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    refusal: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    tool_name: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    tool_args: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    # JSON shape: one attribute with a list of {"parts": [{"type", "content"|"name"|"arguments"}]}.
    messages_json: str | None = None


NEATLOGS = Adapter(
    library="neatlogs",
    llm_kind=("neatlogs.span.kind", ("llm",)),
    input_tokens=("neatlogs.llm.token_count.prompt",),
    output_tokens=("neatlogs.llm.token_count.completion",),
    response_id=("neatlogs.llm.response_id",),
    finish=(r"neatlogs\.llm\.finish_reason", r"neatlogs\.llm\.choices\.\d+\.finish_reason"),
    text=(r"neatlogs\.llm\.output_messages\.\d+\.content",),
    refusal=(r"neatlogs\.llm\.output_messages\.\d+\.refusal",),
    tool_name=(r"neatlogs\.llm\.tool_calls\.(\d+)\.name",),
    tool_args=(r"neatlogs\.llm\.tool_calls\.(\d+)\.arguments",),
)

OPENINFERENCE = Adapter(
    library="openinference",
    llm_kind=("openinference.span.kind", ("LLM",)),
    input_tokens=("llm.token_count.prompt",),
    output_tokens=("llm.token_count.completion",),
    finish=(r"llm\.finish_reason",),
    text=(
        r"llm\.output_messages\.\d+\.message\.content",
        r"llm\.output_messages\.\d+\.message\.contents\.\d+\.message_content\.text",
    ),
    refusal=(r"llm\.output_messages\.\d+\.message\.refusal",),
    tool_name=(r"llm\.output_messages\.(\d+\.message\.tool_calls\.\d+)\.tool_call\.function\.name",),
    tool_args=(r"llm\.output_messages\.(\d+\.message\.tool_calls\.\d+)\.tool_call\.function\.arguments",),
)

OPENLLMETRY = Adapter(
    library="openllmetry",
    # Error spans for failed streams carry no gen_ai.operation.name, so key on the provider.
    llm_kind=("gen_ai.provider.name", ()),
    input_tokens=("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens",),
    output_tokens=("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens",),
    response_id=("gen_ai.response.id",),
    finish=(r"gen_ai\.response\.finish_reasons",),
    messages_json="gen_ai.output.messages",
)

ADAPTERS: dict[str, Adapter] = {a.library: a for a in (NEATLOGS, OPENINFERENCE, OPENLLMETRY)}

# Reasoning text is not output text. OpenInference marks it per content part.
_OI_REASONING = re.compile(r"(llm\.output_messages\.\d+\.message\.contents\.\d+)\.message_content\.text")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SpanFacts:
    """What one LLM span says, in the comparer's terms."""

    input_tokens: int | None
    output_tokens: int | None
    response_id: str | None
    finish: tuple[str, ...]
    texts: tuple[str, ...]
    refusals: tuple[str, ...]
    tool_calls: tuple[tuple[str, Any], ...]  # (name, arguments as recorded)


def _first(attrs: dict[str, Any], keys: tuple[str, ...]) -> Any:
    for k in keys:
        if attrs.get(k) is not None:
            return attrs[k]
    return None


def _matching(attrs: dict[str, Any], patterns: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[tuple[re.Match[str], Any]]:
    out = []
    for p in patterns:
        rx = re.compile(p)
        out += [(m, v) for k, v in attrs.items() if (m := rx.fullmatch(k))]
    return out


def _int(v: Any) -> int | None:
    try:
        return int(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def is_llm_span(adapter: Adapter, span: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    key, values = adapter.llm_kind
    v = span.get("attributes", {}).get(key)
    return v is not None and (not values or v in values)


def _flat_outputs(adapter: Adapter, attrs: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], list[tuple[str, Any]]]:
    texts = []
    for m, v in _matching(attrs, adapter.text):
        rm = _OI_REASONING.fullmatch(m.group(0))
        if rm and attrs.get(f"{rm.group(1)}.message_content.type") == "reasoning":
            continue
        if isinstance(v, str):
            texts.append(v)
    refusals = [v for _, v in _matching(attrs, adapter.refusal) if isinstance(v, str)]
    args = {m.group(1): v for m, v in _matching(attrs, adapter.tool_args)}
    tools = [(v, args.get(m.group(1))) for m, v in _matching(attrs, adapter.tool_name)]
    return texts, refusals, tools


def _json_outputs(raw: Any) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], list[tuple[str, Any]]]:
    texts: list[str] = []
    refusals: list[str] = []
    tools: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
    try:
        messages = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else (raw or [])
    except ValueError:
        return texts, refusals, tools
    for msg in messages if isinstance(messages, list) else []:
        for part in (msg or {}).get("parts", []) if isinstance(msg, dict) else []:
            kind = part.get("type")
            if kind == "text" and isinstance(part.get("content"), str):
                texts.append(part["content"])
            elif kind == "refusal" and isinstance(part.get("content"), str):
                refusals.append(part["content"])
            elif kind == "tool_call":
                tools.append((part.get("name"), part.get("arguments")))
    return texts, refusals, tools


def _finish(adapter: Adapter, attrs: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    out: list[str] = []
    for _, v in _matching(attrs, adapter.finish):
        for x in v if isinstance(v, list) else [v]:
            if isinstance(x, str) and x:
                out.append(x)
    return tuple(out)


def facts(adapter: Adapter, span: dict[str, Any]) -> SpanFacts:
    attrs = span.get("attributes", {})
    if adapter.messages_json:
        texts, refusals, tools = _json_outputs(attrs.get(adapter.messages_json))
    else:
        texts, refusals, tools = _flat_outputs(adapter, attrs)
    rid = _first(attrs, adapter.response_id)
    return SpanFacts(
        input_tokens=_int(_first(attrs, adapter.input_tokens)),
        output_tokens=_int(_first(attrs, adapter.output_tokens)),
        response_id=rid if isinstance(rid, str) else None,
        finish=_finish(adapter, attrs),
        texts=tuple(texts),
        refusals=tuple(refusals),
        tool_calls=tuple(tools),
    )
"""Leads table and leads.json payload. Pure: returns strings and dicts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections import Counter
from typing import Any

from trueup.core.model import Mismatch, Severity

COLUMNS = ("scenario", "check", "expected", "actual", "severity")
CELL_MAX = 48


def _cell(v: Any) -> str:
    s = v if isinstance(v, str) else json.dumps(v, default=str)
    return s if len(s) <= CELL_MAX else s[: CELL_MAX - 3] + "..."


def rows(by_scenario: list[tuple[str, list[Mismatch]]]) -> list[tuple[str, ...]]:
    out = []
    for sid, ms in by_scenario:
        for m in sorted(ms, key=lambda m: -m.severity.rank):
            check = m.check if m.kind == "lead" else f"{m.check} (note)"
            out.append((sid, check, _cell(m.truth), _cell(m.trace), m.severity.value.upper()))
    return out


def table(by_scenario: list[tuple[str, list[Mismatch]]]) -> str:
    body = rows(by_scenario)
    if not body:
        return "no leads"
    widths = [max(len(r[i]) for r in [COLUMNS, *body]) for i in range(len(COLUMNS))]
    line = lambda r: "  ".join(c.ljust(w) for c, w in zip(r, widths)).rstrip()  # noqa: E731
    return "\n".join([line(COLUMNS), line(tuple("-" * w for w in widths)), *(line(r) for r in body)])


def counts(by_scenario: list[tuple[str, list[Mismatch]]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    leads = [m for _, ms in by_scenario for m in ms if m.kind == "lead"]
    notes = [m for _, ms in by_scenario for m in ms if m.kind == "note"]
    sev = Counter(m.severity.value for m in leads)
    return {
        "leads": len(leads),
        "notes": len(notes),
        "by_severity": {s.value: sev.get(s.value, 0) for s in sorted(Severity, reverse=True)},
        "by_check": dict(sorted(Counter(m.check for m in leads).items())),
        "scenarios_with_leads": sum(any(m.kind == "lead" for m in ms) for _, ms in by_scenario),
    }


def leads_payload(run_id: str, library: str, by_scenario: list[tuple[str, list[Mismatch]]],
                  not_run: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "library": library,
        "note": "A lead is a disagreement between truth and trace. It is not a confirmed bug.",
        "counts": counts(by_scenario),
        "not_run": not_run,
        "scenarios": [{"scenario": sid, "mismatches": [m.to_dict() for m in ms]} for sid, ms in by_scenario],
    }
"""trueup sweep <library>: run the plain-SDK scenarios against one library."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from trueup.core import report
from trueup.core.compare import compare, leads
from trueup.core.model import Mismatch, Observation
from trueup.runner import NOT_RUN, RAN, run_scenario, venvs
from trueup.runner.run import not_run
from trueup.scenarios import plain_sdk


def new_run_id(library: str) -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + f"-{library}"


def summary_line(r: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    sid = r["scenario"]
    if r["status"] != RAN:
        return f"{sid:30} NOT RUN  {r['reason']}"
    t, tr = r["observation"]["truth"], r["observation"]["trace"]
    app = t["app"]["outcome"] if t["outcome"] == "ok" else f"raised {t['exception']}"
    spans = ", ".join(f"{s['name']}={s['status']['code']}" for s in tr["spans"]) or "none"
    line = f"{sid:30} ran {r['seconds']:5.1f}s  app {app}; fake calls {t['calls']}; spans {len(tr['spans'])}: {spans}"
    if t.get("expected_mismatch"):
        line += f"  [truth differs from scenario expectation: {', '.join(t['expected_mismatch'])}]"
    return line


def sweep(
    root: Path,
    library: str,
    *,
    ensure: Callable[[Path, str], Path] = venvs.ensure,
    run: Callable[..., dict[str, Any]] = run_scenario,
    out: Callable[[str], None] = print,
) -> tuple[Path, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    run_id = new_run_id(library)
    run_dir = root / ".trueup" / "runs" / run_id
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    started = time.monotonic()
    scenarios = plain_sdk()
    try:
        out(f"preparing venv for {library}")
        python: Path | None = ensure(root, library)
        venv_error = None
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - every scenario is reported NOT RUN
        python, venv_error = None, f"venv not ready: {e}"
    results = []
    for s in scenarios:
        r = not_run(s.id, library, venv_error) if python is None else run(python, library, s.id)
        if r["status"] == RAN:
            r["mismatches"] = [m.to_dict() for m in compare(Observation.from_dict(r["observation"]))]
        results.append(r)
        out(summary_line(r))
        (run_dir / f"{s.id}.json").write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=1, default=str))
    ran = sum(r["status"] == RAN for r in results)
    by = by_scenario(results)
    c = report.counts(by)
    table = report.table(by)
    totals = (f"leads: {c['leads']} (high {c['by_severity']['high']}, medium {c['by_severity']['medium']}, "
              f"low {c['by_severity']['low']})  notes: {c['notes']}")
    lines = [
        f"trueup sweep {library}  run {run_id}",
        f"scenarios: {len(results)}  ran: {ran}  not run: {len(results) - ran}  "
        f"time: {time.monotonic() - started:.0f} s",
        totals,
        "A lead is a disagreement between truth and trace, not a confirmed bug.",
        "",
        *(summary_line(r) for r in results),
        "",
        table,
    ]
    (run_dir / "summary.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    (run_dir / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "run_id": run_id,
        "library": library,
        "scenarios": [{"id": r["scenario"], "status": r["status"], "reason": r["reason"]} for r in results],
    }, indent=1))
    not_run_list = [{"scenario": r["scenario"], "reason": r["reason"]} for r in results if r["status"] != RAN]
    (run_dir / "leads.json").write_text(json.dumps(report.leads_payload(run_id, library, by, not_run_list), indent=1,
                                                   default=str))
    out("")
    out(table)
    out(totals)
    out(f"ran {ran}/{len(results)}; wrote {run_dir}")
    return run_dir, results


def by_scenario(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[tuple[str, list[Mismatch]]]:
    return [(r["scenario"], [Mismatch.from_dict(m) for m in r.get("mismatches", [])])
            for r in results if r["status"] == RAN]


def exit_code(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
    """1 if any lead, else 2 if any scenario could not run, else 0."""
    if any(leads([m for _, ms in by_scenario(results) for m in ms])):
        return 1
    return 2 if not results or any(r["status"] == NOT_RUN for r in results) else 0
"""Command line entry point."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Sequence

from trueup.runner.setups import LIBRARIES

# Exit codes
EXIT_OK = 0  # no mismatches
EXIT_MISMATCH = 1  # mismatches found
EXIT_ERROR = 2  # could not run

KEY_VARS = ("NEATLOGS_API_KEY", "TRUEUP_MODEL_KEY")
NOT_BUILT = ("fix", "upstream", "verify", "report")


def doctor() -> int:
    ok = sys.version_info >= (3, 12)
    v = sys.version_info
    print(f"python: {v.major}.{v.minor}.{v.micro} ({'ok' if ok else 'need 3.12+'})")
    for name in KEY_VARS:
        # Only report presence. Never print the value.
        state = "set" if os.environ.get(name) else "not set"
        print(f"{name}: {state}")
    return EXIT_OK if ok else EXIT_ERROR


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="trueup",
        description="Find where AI agent traces disagree with what really happened.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in NOT_BUILT:
        sub.add_parser(name, help="not built yet")
    sub.add_parser("doctor", help="check the local setup")
    sw = sub.add_parser("sweep", help="run the plain-SDK scenarios against one tracing library")
    sw.add_argument("library", choices=LIBRARIES)
    au = sub.add_parser("audit", help="run your script's main() against the fake provider and compare its trace")
    au.add_argument("script", type=Path, help="Python file with a main() that calls the openai or anthropic SDK")
    au.add_argument("--library", required=True, choices=LIBRARIES, help="tracing library to set up")
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "doctor":
        return doctor()
    if args.command == "sweep":
        from trueup.sweep import exit_code, sweep

        _, results = sweep(Path.cwd(), args.library)
        return exit_code(results)
    if args.command == "audit":
        from trueup.audit import audit
        from trueup.sweep import exit_code

        _, results = audit(Path.cwd(), args.library, args.script)
        return exit_code(results)
    print(f"trueup {args.command}: not built yet", file=sys.stderr)
    return EXIT_ERROR


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"""Data model. Plain dataclasses with to_dict/from_dict. No I/O here."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any


class Severity(Enum):
    HIGH = "high"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    LOW = "low"

    @property
    def rank(self) -> int:
        # Higher rank means more severe.
        return {"high": 3, "medium": 2, "low": 1}[self.value]

    def __lt__(self, other: Severity) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, Severity):
            return NotImplemented
        return self.rank < other.rank

    def __le__(self, other: Severity) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, Severity):
            return NotImplemented
        return self.rank <= other.rank

    def __gt__(self, other: Severity) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, Severity):
            return NotImplemented
        return self.rank > other.rank

    def __ge__(self, other: Severity) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, Severity):
            return NotImplemented
        return self.rank >= other.rank


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Observation:
    """What really happened (truth) next to what the trace recorded (trace)."""

    truth: dict[str, Any]
    trace: dict[str, Any]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"truth": dict(self.truth), "trace": dict(self.trace)}

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: dict[str, Any]) -> Observation:
        return cls(truth=dict(d["truth"]), trace=dict(d["trace"]))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Mismatch:
    """One field where truth and trace disagree.

    kind is "lead" (worth checking; not yet a confirmed bug) or "note" (a fact
    worth recording that is not a disagreement, such as a library changing the
    request).
    """

    field: str
    truth: Any
    trace: Any
    severity: Severity
    check: str = ""
    kind: str = "lead"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

The fake picks each reply from the request: no tool result yet -> a tool call;
tool result present -> the answer (or the scenario's failure).
"""

import json

import openai
import pytest

from trueup.fake import FakeProvider
from trueup.fake.openai_chat import ANSWER
from trueup.fake.openai_responses import UNKNOWN_TOOL
from trueup.runner import framework_apps

Q = [{"role": "user", "content": "weather?"}]
TOOLS = [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "parameters": {"type": "object"}}}]
RESP_TOOLS = [{"type": "function", "name": "get_weather", "parameters": {"type": "object"}}]


@pytest.fixture
def fake():
    with FakeProvider() as f:
        yield f


@pytest.fixture
def oc(fake):
    return openai.OpenAI(api_key="x", base_url=fake.openai_base_url, max_retries=0)


def _after_tool(msg, call_ids):
    return Q + [msg.model_dump(exclude_none=True)] + [
        {"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": cid, "content": "Sunny"} for cid in call_ids
    ]


# Chat Completions agent flows


def test_chat_agent_tool_call_then_answer(fake, oc):
    r1 = oc.chat.completions.create(model="agent-chat", messages=Q, tools=TOOLS)
    (tc,) = r1.choices[0].message.tool_calls
    assert (tc.function.name, json.loads(tc.function.arguments)) == ("get_weather", {"city": "Lagos"})
    assert r1.choices[0].finish_reason == "tool_calls"
    r2 = oc.chat.completions.create(model="agent-chat", messages=_after_tool(r1.choices[0].message, [tc.id]))
    assert r2.choices[0].message.content == ANSWER and r2.choices[0].finish_reason == "stop"
    log = fake.log.entries()
    assert [e["outcome"] for e in log] == ["complete", "complete"]
    assert [len(e["tool_calls"]) for e in log] == [1, 0] and log[1]["text"] == [ANSWER]


def test_chat_agent_parallel_tools(fake, oc):
    r = oc.chat.completions.create(model="agent-chat-parallel", messages=Q, tools=TOOLS)
    args = [json.loads(t.function.arguments)["city"] for t in r.choices[0].message.tool_calls]
    assert args == ["Lagos", "Abuja"]
    assert len({t.id for t in r.choices[0].message.tool_calls}) == 2

    r1 = oc.chat.completions.create(model="agent-chat-loop", messages=Q, tools=TOOLS)
    tc = r1.choices[0].message.tool_calls[0]
    r2 = oc.chat.completions.create(model="agent-chat-loop", messages=_after_tool(r1.choices[0].message, [tc.id]))
    assert r2.choices[0].message.tool_calls and r2.choices[0].message.tool_calls[0].id != tc.id

    r1 = oc.chat.completions.create(model="agent-chat-fail2", messages=Q, tools=TOOLS)
    tc = r1.choices[0].message.tool_calls[0]
    with pytest.raises(openai.InternalServerError):
        oc.chat.completions.create(model="agent-chat-fail2", messages=_after_tool(r1.choices[0].message, [tc.id]))
    assert [e["outcome"] for e in fake.log.entries()] == ["complete", "http_error"]

    "response.created", "response.in_progress", "response.output_item.added", "response.content_part.added",
